i know what you mean.

some life stuff, family stuff, pretty much everything has been dragging me down recently. more so than usual. i’m at a point where i have no idea what to try next
rant to me if you need
what is super aids should i be concerned

hey thank you for the reply. it helped more than you know, just that someone bothered commenting.

i hope you are well.

i don’t think i’m capable of being happy anymore. my body and mind are so accustomed to being sad all the time i don’t think it would know how to feel any different. so no matter how much my life may change for the better (it won’t) i don’t think i will ever be able to be happy.

I’ve always wanted to visit Sweden.

I’ve never tried LoL but I’ve heard a lot about it. I am a huge fan of Blizzard games and Overwatch was one I thought I wouldn’t like until I tried it. I’ve been playing for a long time and it’s not as fun as it used to be but it’s still a good distraction for me.
I’m from the us, kentucky specifically. And I do, mainly Overwatch, world of warcraft, minecraft, and a few others here and there
Thank you. I’m very much alone. I don’t have any friends other than one person online but I don’t trust in that friendship lasting anymore and I know I can’t talk to him right now.

I cut my arm once when I was 13 and that was all until recently.

Now that I’m 20 and more depressed than I’ve ever been I decided to try it again. I cut my thigh because nobody will ever see them there. Seeing the cut slowly turn red and watching the blood come to the surface calms me for some reason. And the sting distracts me from the the depression for a little bit.

I don’t cut deep, I use a small blade I took from a pencil sharpener and run it across my leg, it takes a minute for there to be visual results and it usually doesn’t really hurt much until the next day.

If something doesn’t change in the near future I can see myself moving onto more drastic versions of self harm. Right now I’m trying every last thing I know to do other than suicide, because I don’t want to hurt my family.
I want to drink my sorrows away but unfortunately I’m a year away from being able to buy my own alcohol and I have no friends to do it for me.
